messages:
Tasha Nguyen: Quick ask — need a concise 1-page field brief + tweet thread that ties deploy-mode decision to security and our benchmark narrative. Target AEs and webinar follow-ups.
Devin Park: Happy to draft. Do you want a single decision-flow one-pager or separate short briefs per mode?
Tasha Nguyen: Single decision flow preferred. Must surface the common customer triggers -> recommended mode, one short security callout block, and a tiny benchmark blurb we can cite in slides.
Casey Liu: I can mock the decision SVG. Propose three trigger rows: speed/low-latency -> Hosted, steady high throughput -> Dedicated, regulated/compliant -> Private. Will keep iconography minimal.
Ashok Rao: Security bullets to include: KMS/HSM integration, audit logs, per-route SLOs & policy fallbacks, RBAC. Also 2-line compliance checklist (data residency + encryption-at-rest).
Maria Gomez: I'll draft the tweet thread + CTA. CTA: "Request a deploy-readiness review" + 1-min intake form with fields: model family, region, compliance flag. We'll map flags to routing rules.
Devin Park: Draft benchmark phrasing for the brief/webinar: "In our multi-customer benchmark, Redwood reduced 95th-percentile latency by ~30ms on short chat workloads and lowered per-token infra cost by ~20% using automatic batching and KV caching." Will attach test rig notes.
Casey Liu: Add one sentence for business impact: "This typically yielded ~2x higher throughput per GPU and ~10-15% lower inferred infra spend in our sample app runs." Keep ranges conservative.
Tasha Nguyen: Routing rules for intake: if compliance flag == private -> route to Enterprise AE; if SLA-sensitive (tail latency requirement) -> AE priority queue; else -> SDR. Tag every lead with model and region.
Maria Gomez: For HubSpot/SFDC: I'll add a custom field "deploy_need" with values {hosted, dedicated, private} and a workflow to set AE assignment. Also draft the webhook payload for intake.
Ashok Rao: Legal/Compliance note: include a short footnote: "Benchmarks measured on representative open model families, seq len 256-512, T4-class hardware; results may vary by model/config."
Devin Park: I'll provide the metric phrasing and the minimal test-rig copy for legal review (model family, batching config, latency window).
Casey Liu: Layout suggestion: left column = decision flow (icons + 1-line trigger each). Right column top = Security/SLA bullets (4 bullets). Right column bottom = benchmark callout + CTA. Microcopy only, <=12 words per bullet.
Tasha Nguyen: Timeline: first draft in 24 hours, internal review within 48 hours, field-ready PDF + tweet thread + webinar follow-up copy by EOD next week. Drop everything in /drive/marketing/field-briefs/deploy-decider.
Maria Gomez: Tweet thread outline I'll drop: 3 tweets — (1) rubrics for choosing a deployment, (2) benchmark highlight + biz impact, (3) CTA + intake link. Will include suggested hashtags and alt text for the SVG.
marketing-bot: Reminder set — follow-up sync in 24 hours.
_meta_note: Per agents.md: messages is a single continuous string containing the root message and replies in chronological order. No title field included.
